summary: A small helper that joins style class names together and merges conflicting Tailwind style classes.
purpose: Lets components build their style text from conditions and still have the last matching style win, instead of two styles fighting each other.
why: Common pattern in Tailwind projects. The reason for merging conflicts is inferred from its use with the style merge library, which is standard practice.
how: Takes any number of class names, conditions, or lists, joins them with the joining library, then merges conflicting Tailwind classes so only the last one remains.
inputs: Class names, optional classes, or lists of them, passed by components.
outputs: A single cleaned class text string for a component to use.
risks: Low risk. A wrong style class passed in will still be applied, since the helper does not check if a class exists.
debug: If a style looks wrong, print the output of this helper for that component and check which class won.
